description: This is a Java test class for the Obs class within the OpenMRS core API, containing unit tests for various Obs methods and properties.

classes.name: ObsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OpenMRS Obs class, testing various functionalities and properties of the Obs object.

methods.name: shouldAddandRemoveObsToGroup
methods.description: Tests adding and removing Obs instances to an Obs group, including edge cases and exception handling.

methods.name: shouldGetRelatedObservations
methods.description: Verifies the getRelatedObservations method returns the correct related observations at various hierarchy levels.

methods.name: isComplex_shouldReturnTrueIfTheConceptIsComplex
methods.description: Checks that isComplex() correctly identifies complex concept datatypes.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures that setting an empty string value throws an exception if the concept datatype is not string.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that setting a null value throws an exception.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldNotFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsBlankAndTypeIsST
methods.description: Confirms that blank string input is accepted for string concepts.

methods.name: setValueAsString_shouldFailIfTheValueOfTheStringIsBlankAndTypeIsNotST
methods.description: Checks that blank string input throws exception for non-string concept datatypes.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnFalseForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIs0
methods.description: Tests getValueAsBoolean returns false when valueNumeric is 0.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnNullForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIsNeither1Nor0
methods.description: Checks getValueAsBoolean returns null when valueNumeric is not 0 or 1.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnNonPreciseValuesForNumericConcepts
methods.description: Verifies getValueAsString returns correct string representation for numeric concepts without decimal.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldNotReturnLongDecimalNumbersAsScientificNotation
methods.description: Ensures large numeric values are not displayed in scientific notation.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnDateInCorrectFormat
methods.description: Checks that date values are formatted correctly as strings.

methods.name: getValueAsBoolean_shouldReturnTrueForValue_numericConceptsIfValueIs1
methods.description: Tests getValueAsBoolean returns true when valueNumeric is 1.

methods.name: getGroupMembers_shouldGetAllGroupMembersIfPassedTrueAndNonvoidedIfPassedFalse
methods.description: Validates retrieval of group members based on filtering voided entries.

methods.name: hasGroupMembers_shouldReturnTrueIfThisObsHasGroupMembersBasedOnParameter
methods.description: Tests method correctly identifies presence of group members with filtering for voided status.

methods.name: isObsGrouping_shouldIncludeVoidedObs
methods.description: Checks that isObsGrouping accounts for voided group members.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldUseCommasOrDecimalPlacesDependingOnLocale
methods.description: Verifies locale-sensitive number formatting.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldNotUseThousandSeparator
methods.description: Ensures large numbers are formatted without thousand separators in string output.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnRegularNumberForSizeOfZeroToOrGreaterThanTenDigits
methods.description: Checks that numbers are returned as plain strings for specific sizes.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnRegularNumberIfDecimalPlacesAreAsHighAsSix
methods.description: Verifies decimal precision handling in string output.

methods.name: getValueAsString_shouldReturnLocalizedCodedConcept
methods.description: Tests localization of coded concept values.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenNoChangeHasBeenMade
methods.description: Ensures isDirty returns false if no modifications are made to the Obs.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnyImmutableFieldHasBeenChangedForEditedObs
methods.description: Validates that modifications to immutable fields set the dirty flag.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenAnyImmutableFieldHasBeenChangedForNewObs
methods.description: Checks that new Obs does not get marked dirty when immutable fields are changed.

methods.name: updateImmutableFieldsAndAssert
methods.description: Helper to test that changing immutable fields marks the Obs as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenOnlyMutableFieldsAreChanged
methods.description: Tests that changing mutable fields does not set the dirty flag.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValueForEditedObs
methods.description: Checks if setting immutable fields to null correctly marks the entity as dirty.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalsWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValueInNewObs
methods.description: Ensures new Obs doesn’t get marked dirty if immutable fields are set to null.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnTrueWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValueInExistingObs
methods.description: Tests that setting immutable fields from null to non-null marks dirty.

methods.name: isDirty_shouldReturnFalseWhenAnImmutableFieldIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValueInNewObs
methods.description: Verifies new Obs remains clean when immutable fields are set to non-null.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueHasNotBeenChanged
methods.description: Checks that setting the same form field values does not mark the object as dirty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueHasBeenChanged
methods.description: Confirms that changing form field values marks the object as dirty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueIsChangedFromANonNullToANullValue
methods.description: Ensures setting form fields to null when they previously had values marks dirty.

methods.name: setFormField_shouldMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheValueIsChangedFromANullToANonNullValue
methods.description: Checks that setting form fields from null to non-null marks dirty.

methods.name: addGroupMember_shouldReturnFalseWhenADuplicateObsIsAddedAsAMember
methods.description: Tests that adding duplicate group members does not mark the Obs as dirty.

methods.name: removeGroupMember_shouldReturnFalseWhenANonExistentObsIsRemoved
methods.description: Tests removing an Obs that is not a group member does not mark as dirty.

methods.name: removeGroupMember_shouldReturnDirtyFalseWhenAnObsIsRemoved
methods.description: Validates that removing a group member resets dirty flag status.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheExistingObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToANonEmptyOne
methods.description: Verifies setting a new group members set from null does not mark dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkNewObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToANonEmptyOne
methods.description: Checks non-entity object’s dirty state when group members are set.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheExistingObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithDifferentMembers
methods.description: Ensures replacing a group members set with a different one does not mark as dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheNewObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithDifferentMembers
methods.description: Similar to above, confirms non-dirty status with different members.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsChangedFromNullToAnEmptyOne
methods.description: Validates that setting an empty group members set from null does not mark dirty.

methods.name: setGroupMembers_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenTheSetIsReplacedWithAnotherWithSameMembers
methods.description: Checks that assigning equivalent group members sets does not mark dirty.

methods.name: setObsDateTime_shouldNotMarkTheObsAsDirtyWhenDateIsNotChangedAndExistingValueIsOfTimeStampType
methods.description: Verifies that setting the same date or timestamp does not alter dirty status.

methods.name: shouldSetFinalStatusOnNewObsByDefault
methods.description: Confirms that new Obs instances default to FINAL status.

methods.name: newInstance_shouldCopyMostFields
methods.description: Tests the static method to clone an Obs object, verifying deep copy of fields.

methods.name: shouldSupportInterpretationProperty
methods.description: Checks getter and setter for the interpretation property.

methods.name: setValueBoolean_shouldNotSetValueForNonBooleanConcept
methods.description: Ensures that setting a boolean value on non-boolean concepts does not alter current coded value.
